sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:893–926 evaluates transient inner ratios using gradients/limiter frozen at start of physical step; selected metadata reports zero misses but does not establish fully refreshed nonlinear residual. All selected steady metadata report 100% inner target misses (Re20 794/794, M015 inviscid 1034/1034). BDF2 and implicit SGS are implemented; final source differs.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global mesh is released before solve (main.cpp:81–84,151–168); METIS/halo and reductions exist. Re20 selected np4/np8 Cl tail means +0.012703/−0.389676 differ by 0.40238, Cd 0.91697/0.84691 differ 7.6%. Both metadata name bf6e816 and step-0 forces match roundoff, but np4 command omits exact CLI controls; DQ4 unresolved.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected Re20 settled Cd0.8469 and Cl-0.3897, physically inaccurate for symmetric cylinder; report discloses. Re200 St0.11281 for t>=105 but dominant raw FFT peak changes to ≈0.075 for t>=100. All steady force plots are unreadable at t=0; raw case values survive.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2 retained: prior assertion of no committed frequency is false: immutable b962bf5 report.tex:632–643 and included re200_stats.tex give St=0.11281, mean Cd=1.12646 and lift rms=0.02664. Visually inspected committed forces.png: startup drag spike ≈30 compresses late Cd; lift_history.png shows lift only, not a readable late drag plot. Re200 floor therefore remains unmet. Raw forces span 300.01 time units, last 10% Cd 1.00484–1.24917 and Cl -0.08188–0.08706; dominant St is below canonical ~0.2, but independent periodicity/source/DQ review remains open. Metadata revision bf6e816 differs from final fv_solver.cpp. No unsteady rerun.
